anchor.semantic_hook: Clarity is made literal through large transparent nonalphabetic glyph forms arranged in a perfectly orderly row.
anchor.setting: An austere civic hall contains a long stone table, a lectern, and tall windows admitting clean daylight. Across the back wall, enormous transparent nonalphabetic glyph sculptures stand in a precise row, each shape distinct but unreadable. Their clear surfaces cast crisp, unobstructed shadows across the floor.

anchor.semantic_hook: Remedying is staged as the direct physical repair of a damaged surface at the center of the scene.
